messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: MSStats pipeline for fragpipe and dia-nn?
parts:
Hi,


currently, Fragpipe converter is only available for TMT data. DIA-NN converter is available in GitHub version of MSstatsConvert and MSstats packages on diann-converter branches.
After some basic data manipulations, MSstatsConvert package can be used to convert data from both FragPipe and DIA-NN to MSstats format.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
